edges.description: An episode of stress-provoked deterioration may itself progress to unexplained coma, which in the original series followed infections and minor head traumas.

Fever activates the same integrated stress response that the eIF2B defect already deregulates, so the exposure amplifies an ISR that is abnormal at baseline. EXACERBATES rather than TRIGGERS: the genetic defect, not the infection, establishes the deregulated state.
The episode of acute decline itself does not occur without a stressor, so the exposure initiates it rather than amplifying it; the intermediate is the ISR node above.
Head trauma is one of the physiological stressors that precipitates an episode of rapid neurological deterioration on top of the chronic progressive course.

Inhalation anaesthetics act on the same integrated stress response that the eIF2B defect already deregulates, so the exposure pushes an already-abnormal ISR further and is the proposed route by which anaesthesia provokes acute decline.
Immature white matter astrocytes precede onset and parallel severity and progression, and mutant astrocytes inhibit oligodendrocyte maturation in coculture, as the node describes.
edges.limitations: Severity in mice is set by the allele combination bred, so the graded series models the human genotype-severity relationship only for the two alleles studied.

nodes.description: Lithium was tested as an indirect eIF2B activator through GSK3-beta inhibition. nodes.description: White matter astrocytes are the primary affected cell type in VWM. Impaired astrocyte maturation precedes disease onset and parallels severity; immature, morphologically abnormal astrocytes secrete factors that inhibit oligodendrocyte maturation, while wild-type astrocytes permit normal maturation of mutant oligodendrocytes. Specialized astrocytes such as cerebellar Bergmann glia and retinal Mueller cells are also involved.

nodes.description: The 2025 international consensus guideline classified clinically used drugs by their effect on the integrated stress response. Inhalation anaesthetics such as sevoflurane, the agents most commonly used to induce anaesthesia in children, fall in the ISR-activating group, and anaesthesia is one of the few drug exposures with direct clinical evidence of provoking an episode of acute decline in VWM. The guideline recommends considering non-ISR-activating alternatives such as propofol.

nodes.description: Febrile infections are the most common trigger of an episode of rapid neurological deterioration in VWM, and the guideline states the mechanism explicitly: fever activates the integrated stress response, which the eIF2B defect has already deregulated. This is why the entry's management side recommends vaccination, antipyretics, and a lower threshold for antibiotics.

nodes.description: Disease-modifying approaches target the deregulated integrated stress response. The eIF2B activator ISRIB normalized ISR mRNA markers and ameliorated neuropathology in VWM mice, and the FDA-approved alpha2-agonist guanabenz, which modulates eIF2 phosphorylation/eIF2B activity, improved Bergmann glia and cerebellar myelin pathology in VWM mice. Guanabenz has since been taken into humans: a single-arm phase 1/2 trial in 33 children with early-childhood-onset VWM reported a significantly lower risk of losing the ability to walk with support than in 66 matched untreated historical controls, at the cost of a substantial adverse-event burden dominated by transient hallucinations. The comparison was non-randomised and the authors call for confirmation in a long-term extension study, so guanabenz is an investigational therapy with the first human efficacy signal rather than an established one. The direct eIF2B activator fosigotifator (ABBV-CLS-7262) is in an ongoing open-label phase 1b/2 study. See the clinical_trials block.

nodes.description: Minor head trauma is the second most common trigger of an episode of acute decline in VWM, after febrile infection. The guideline recommends avoiding it as far as is reasonable, and GeneReviews recommends helmet use in children for the same reason. Unlike fever, no source in the cache states that head trauma acts by activating the ISR, so it is linked only to the stress-provoked deterioration node and not to the ISR node.
